heading: INT. CLOSED FUNICULAR STATION - CAR HOUSE - DAY

units.text: INT. CLOSED FUNICULAR STATION - CAR HOUSE - DAY
A dusty hillside funicular terminal.
Two wooden cars rest on rails that slope up into a tunnel.
Sunlight drips through slatted windows.
A card table is set up between the cars, covered in blueprints, a thermos, and a plate of lemon biscuits.
FELIX "THE CLOCK" BRANDTNER (60s, vest, pocket watch) pours tea.
BIANCA MORETTI (30s, tool belt, calm eyes) sketches on a napkin.
Big DESMOND "DEZ" OKONKWO (40s, forearms like cables) polishes a wrench.
Young TOBIAS PIKE (20s, nervous, tall) clutches a thermos.
And RENATA "RENNY" SILVA (50s, reading glasses, ledger) turns pages.
Biscuit, Bianca?
units.name: FELIX

units.text: Not now, Felix. The cable tension is wrong.
units.name: BIANCA

units.text: It's been wrong since 1962, Bee.
units.name: DEZ

units.text: And the vault is exactly where it's been since 1962, Dez.
units.name: RENNY

units.text: Is it, though? I looked at the survey and the vault is on the--
units.name: TOBIAS

units.text: Tobias, my boy, finish your tea.
units.name: FELIX

units.text: I'm just saying, Clock, the survey shows--
units.name: TOBIAS

units.text: --the east wall, Toby, I know. I drew it.
units.name: BIANCA

units.text: So we go up the east wall.
units.name: DEZ

units.text: We go up Thursday. Nobody does anything today.
units.name: RENNY

units.text: Splendid. Renny, you keep the ledger.
units.name: FELIX

units.text: I always keep the ledger, Felix.
units.name: RENNY

units.text: Bee, pass me the biscuits.
units.name: DEZ

units.text: Dez, you have a wrench in your hand.
units.name: BIANCA

units.text: I have two hands.
units.name: DEZ

units.text: Tobias, finally, takes a biscuit.
Everyone watches him chew.
He nods.
Thursday.
units.name: TOBIAS

units.text: Thursday.
units.name: FELIX
